title: Aero-Wheeldrag-Fix
description: A physics tweak for Create Aeronautics that makes wheel mount drag fully customizable so aircraft can overcome speed limits to take off. It preserves normal ground handling and allows landing brakes to be toggled via Redstone.
body:
A physics configuration utility for Create Aeronautics that makes wheel mount rolling drag fully customizable, allowing you to fine-tune or entirely remove the forward resistance that prevents aircraft from reaching takeoff speeds.

Features
Customizable Rolling Friction: Adjust the forward drag coefficient via a simple config file to ensure your vehicles never get stuck at arbitrary speed caps on the runway.

Intact Handling: Side traction, suspension behavior, and taxi steering remain completely untouched for stable ground control.

Redstone Braking: The friction bypass automatically disables when the wheel mount receives a Redstone signal, preserving full runway landing brake functionality.
